name: clean-history
description: Remove old workflow run history, keeping a minimum number of days and runs per workflow.

github-token.description: GitHub token with actions:read and actions:write permissions.

min-days.description: Minimum number of complete days of history to keep per workflow.

min-runs.description: Minimum number of most-recent runs to keep per workflow, regardless of age.

workflows.description: Comma-separated list of workflow file names to clean (e.g. deploy.yml,clean.yml). Defaults to all workflows in the repository.
